title: Customer Insights Analyst
text: Customer Insights Analyst at Bluefin Resources Pty Limited (Sydney, Ryde & Macquarie Park; Full Time; salary: not stated). Our client, a respected and well-known brand in their market, are currently experiencing growth in their Customer Insights team. There is an excellent opportunity for a Customer Insights analyst to join this team of four and assist with building innovative analytics solutions that assist the business and marketing with key outcomes. Key responsibilities for the role; Lead the strategy, design and testing of analytics implementations Transform analytical output into actionable insights, and engage clients throughout the process Ensure quality control and oversight of reporting output Refine and optimise campaign activities based on post-campaign analysis to maximise profitability Proactively engage with stakeholders by supplying customer insights & assist marketing with strategy recommendations To be successful for the role you will have; A degree in Actuarial, Maths / Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics is preferred 4 + years' experience working on data analysis and insights, ideally from a marketing context You must be highly skilled in writing complex SQL queries Proven experience of driving insights from data and presenting the findings to different sets of stakeholders Experience and knowledge of advanced analytics Must be technically strong in SQL, SPSS, Excel and PowerPoint The ability to observe and interpret customer data, an understanding of loyalty programmes would be highly advantageous If this sounds of interest to you, please call Sophie Monaghan immediately on 02 2970 2603 or APPLY via the link IMPORTANT: By submitting your email address and any other personal information when you APPLY to a job, you consent to such information being collected, held, used and disclosed in accordance with our COLLECTIONS NOTICE and PRIVACY POLICY. http://www.bluefinresources.com.au/privacy-policy
